claims.wording: Redline is an AI agent I am building that reads a Chicago correction letter and drafts a response package for the architect to review: each comment sorted, cited to a code section, routed to whoever has to act, and drafted.

For Chicago, it has only been tested on correction letters we wrote ourselves. No architect has checked its answers and no city has reviewed its output, so I cannot tell you it would hold up with a real plan examiner.
Anything that needs a licensed professional's judgment is held for their sign-off.
In November 2024 the Chicago Department of Buildings told the City Council that plan-based permits averaged 71 days that October, 50 of them with the applicant or design professional.
